_note: Generic, brand-free everyday dishes cookable in under an hour. All quantities are PER SERVE (portions: 1); the app multiplies by the number of people. Ingredients reference ingredients.json by id; Recipes carry no tags (#181); allergens come from their ingredients.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
method: Finely dice the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and soften in olive oil.
Brown the mince, then stir in tomato paste and crushed tomatoes; simmer 30 minutes.
Cook spaghetti, toss with sauce and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
method: Cook the jasmine rice, spread it on a tray and let it cool for 10 minutes (or use day-old cooked rice).
Scramble eggs in a hot wok with the vegetable oil, remove; stir-fry garlic, diced carrot and drained peas.
Add rice, soy sauce, sesame oil, egg and sliced spring onion; toss until hot.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
method: Marinate diced chicken in yoghurt and half the spices for 15 minutes.
Sear chicken in butter; remove. Soften onion, garlic and ginger, add remaining spices and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice.
Blend sauce if desired, return chicken, stir in cream and simmer until cooked. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Greek salad with haloumi
method: Chop tomato, cucumber, capsicum and onion; add olives and crumbled feta.
Dress with olive oil, vinegar and oregano.
Pan-fry sliced haloumi until golden and serve on top.

recipes.name: San choy bau
method: Stir-fry garlic and ginger, add pork mince and cook until browned.
Add diced water chestnuts, oyster sauce, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Spoon into lettuce cups and top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Chicken korma
method: Fry the sliced onion in oil until soft and golden.
Add grated garlic and ginger, then the spices, and cook for a minute.
Add diced chicken and brown it.
Stir in the yoghurt and almond meal with a splash of water and simmer for 20 minutes, cooking the basmati rice meanwhile.
Stir through the cream, season, and serve with basmati rice.

recipes.name: Red lentil dahl
method: Rinse the lentils and simmer with turmeric and 250 ml water for 20 minutes until soft; cook the basmati rice meanwhile.
In a separate pan, melt the butter and fry the cumin seeds until they crackle.
Add diced onion, garlic and ginger and cook until golden, then add chopped tomato.
Stir the onion mixture and garam masala into the lentils and season.
Serve with the rice and chopped coriander.

recipes.name: Beef keema with peas
method: Fry the diced onion in oil until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and chilli, then the cumin and ground coriander.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes, cooking the basmati rice meanwhile.
Add the peas and garam masala and cook for 5 minutes more.
Season, top with coriander and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Potato, cauliflower and chickpea curry
method: Fry the diced onion in oil, then add garlic, ginger and the ground spices.
Add diced potato and cauliflower florets and stir to coat.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes until the potato is tender, cooking the basmati rice meanwhile.
Stir in the drained chickpeas, spinach and garam masala until the spinach wilts.
Season and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Shaking beef (bò lúc lắc)
method: Cut the beef into 3 cm cubes and marinate with half the garlic, oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and pepper for 15 minutes.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Arrange shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and thinly sliced red onion on a platter.
Heat oil in a wok until smoking and sear the beef in batches, shaking the pan, for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the butter and remaining garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Pile the beef over the salad and serve with rice and a lime, salt and pepper dipping mix.

recipes.name: Lemongrass chilli chicken (gà xào sả ớt)
method: Finely chop the white part of the lemongrass, the garlic and the chilli.
Toss bite-sized chicken pieces with half the lemongrass, the fish sauce, sugar and turmeric, and rest for 15 minutes.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the remaining lemongrass, garlic and chilli in oil until fragrant.
Add the chicken and sliced onion and stir-fry until caramelised and cooked through.
Top with coriander and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lemongrass beef noodle salad (bún bò xào)
method: Make the dressing (nước chấm) by stirring 2 tsp of the fish sauce, the sugar, lime juice, vinegar, sliced chilli, half the garlic and 3 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves.
Thinly slice the beef and marinate with chopped lemongrass, the remaining garlic and the remaining 1 tsp fish sauce for 15 minutes.
Cook the vermicelli, rinse in cold water and drain.
Shred the lettuce, julienne the carrot and cucumber, and pick the mint leaves.
Stir-fry the beef and sliced onion in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Build bowls of salad, noodles and beef, and top with crushed peanuts and dressing.

recipes.name: Prawn and pork rice paper rolls (gỏi cuốn)
method: Simmer the pork belly in salted water for 20 minutes, cool, then slice thinly.
Cook the vermicelli, rinse in cold water and drain.
Peel and halve the prawns lengthways, and cut the cucumber into sticks.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds and lay it flat.
Layer lettuce, noodles, herbs, cucumber and pork, add 3 prawn halves, then fold in the sides and roll tightly.
For the dip, loosen the hoisin with a little warm water and top with crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Pork chops with apples and onion
method: Take the chops out of the fridge 15 minutes early, pat them dry, snip the fat edge in a couple of spots so they sit flat, and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Core the apples and cut them into thick wedges, skin on. Slice the onion into thin half-moons.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chops for 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and just cooked through. Move them to a plate to rest.
Turn the heat down to medium, add the butter, then the onion, and cook for about 5 minutes until soft and starting to colour.
Add the apple wedges and cook, turning now and then, for 5 to 6 minutes until tender and caramelised at the edges but still holding their shape.

Splash in a few tablespoons of water and scrape up the browned bits, then return the chops and any resting juices to the pan and warm through for a minute. Season to taste and serve with the apples and onion spooned over.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with garlic, chilli and parmesan
method: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until just tender, about 10 minutes. Keep a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a large frying pan over low heat and gently cook the thinly sliced garlic and chilli for 2 to 3 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold.
Add the drained spaghetti, the spinach and a splash of the cooking water, and toss until the spinach wilts and the pasta is glossy.
Take off the heat, toss through most of the grated parmesan, season with salt and pepper and serve with the rest of the parmesan on top.

recipes.name: Tuna, tomato and olive spaghetti
method: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until just tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, fry the sliced garlic in the olive oil for a minute, then add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and the halved olives and warm through.
Toss the drained spaghetti through the sauce, season with pepper and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom and spinach spaghetti
method: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until just tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a frying pan and cook the sliced mushrooms over high heat for 5 minutes until browned, adding the crushed garlic for the last minute.
Pour in the cream, simmer for 2 minutes, then stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Toss the drained spaghetti and most of the parmesan through the sauce, loosening with a little pasta water. Season and serve with the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
method: Cook the jasmine rice.
Slice the beef thinly across the grain and cut the broccoli into small florets.
Heat half the oil in a wok until smoking and sear the beef for 1 to 2 minutes; set aside.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar and toss for a minute until glossy. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Honey soy chicken with rice
method: Cook the jasmine rice.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and brown it in the vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until cooked through.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, crushed garlic, grated ginger and sesame oil, pour over the chicken and bubble for 2 minutes until sticky.
Serve over the rice, scattered with sliced spring onion.

recipes.name: Spiced chicken wraps with corn and avocado
method: Rub the chicken with the cumin, chilli powder, a pinch of salt and half the oil, then cook in a hot frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Meanwhile, char the corn cob in the same pan or over a flame for 5 minutes, then cut off the kernels.
Mix the corn with diced tomato, finely chopped red onion, the rest of the oil and half the lime juice.
Mash the avocado with the remaining lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the wraps, spread with avocado and fill with salad leaves, chicken and the corn salsa.

recipes.name: Beef chilli with rice
method: Fry the diced onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chilli powder and cumin for a minute.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up, for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and crushed tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes, until thick, cooking the rice meanwhile.
Season and serve over the rice with grated cheddar and a spoonful of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Shakshuka (eggs in spiced tomato)
method: Fry the sliced onion and capsicum in the olive oil in a small frying pan for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and chilli powder for a minute, then the tomatoes, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Season.
Make two hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with crumbled feta and chopped coriander and serve with the bread roll.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma wraps with garlic yoghurt
method: Mix the oil, the spices, half the garlic and half the lemon juice; toss the chicken in it and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Stir the rest of the garlic and lemon juice into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt.
Warm the wraps and fill with shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and cucumber, the chicken and the garlic yoghurt.

recipes.name: Thai pork larb in lettuce cups
method: Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the pork mince in the oil over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked and lightly browned.
Take off the heat and stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, sliced chilli and thinly sliced red onion.
Toss through the mint and coriander leaves and spoon into lettuce cups. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Thai chicken and coconut soup
method: Bring the coconut milk and 200 ml water to a simmer with the lemongrass and sliced ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the thinly sliced chicken and sliced mushrooms and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice, tasting as you go.
Serve in a bowl topped with sliced chilli and coriander.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken with potatoes
method: Cut the potato into 2 cm cubes and boil for 8 minutes until just tender; drain.
Meanwhile, toss the chicken with half the oil, the oregano, crushed garlic, half the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook the chicken in a large frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through; set aside to rest.
Fry the potatoes in the rest of the oil in the same pan for 8 to 10 minutes until golden, then squeeze over the remaining lemon.
Serve the chicken and potatoes with the salad leaves and crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Sausages with mash and peas
method: Boil the peeled, chopped potato for 15 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, cook the sausages in the oil in a frying pan over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Add the sliced onion for the last 8 minutes to soften and brown.
Drain the potato and mash it with the butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Warm the drained peas and serve with the mash, sausages and onions.

recipes.name: Bacon, eggs, mushrooms and toast
method: Fry the bacon in a large frying pan for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp; keep warm.
In the bacon fat, cook the sliced mushrooms and the halved tomato, cut side down, for 5 minutes. Add the spinach for the last minute to wilt.
Fry the eggs in half the butter to your liking while the bread toasts.
Butter the toast and serve with everything, seasoned with pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken, avocado and corn salad
method: Season the chicken and cook it in half the oil in a frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through; rest and slice.
Cook the corn cob in the same pan for 5 minutes, turning, until charred in spots, then cut off the kernels.
Toss the salad leaves, diced tomato and cucumber with the rest of the oil, the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Top with the corn, sliced avocado and chicken.

recipes.name: Porridge with blueberries and honey
method: Stir the oats and milk in a small saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Pour into a bowl and top with the blueberries.
Drizzle with honey and serve.
